provenance_quote: One of the secreted proteins is PrtA, which is shown here to be a repeats-in-toxin (RTX) alkaline zinc metalloprotease. ... The prtA gene resides in a locus encoding both the protease ABC transporter (prtBCD) and an intervening ORF encoding a protease inhibitor (inh).
notes: DOI 10.1099/mic.0.26171-0 = Bowen 2003 Microbiology, PMID 12777498, resolves and on-topic. RTX metalloprotease secreted via prtBCD ABC transporter = canonical T1SS. UniProt Q84F70 live, reviewed, GN Name=prtA1, DE Serralysin / Secreted alkaline metalloproteinase, OS Photorhabdus luminescens (Xenorhabdus luminescens) = matches gene+organism. Subcellular location: Secreted. effector_locus AACX37_RS13005 / genome NZ_CAWQBW010000010.1 are the benchmark-assembly identifiers, not in the 2003 paper but consistent with P. luminescens prtA; not disconfirmed.

provenance_quote: The gene encoding the secreted 53-kDa metalloprotease (protease B) ... do not have typical signal sequences at their NH2 termini. Both proteases are synthesized as inactive higher molecular weight precursors (zymogens proB and proC) which are secreted into the external medium
notes: DOI 10.1016/S0021-9258(18)81905-6 = Delepelaire & Wandersman 1989 J Biol Chem 264:9083-9, PMID 2722818, resolves and on-topic (Protease secretion by Erwinia chrysanthemi; proteases B and C secreted as zymogens without signal peptide = signal-independent T1SS). UniProt P16316 live, DE Serralysin B / Secreted protease B (ProB), GN Name=prtB, OS Dickeya chrysanthemi (Erwinia chrysanthemi) = matches gene+organism. effector_locus CO076_RS11485 / NZ_CP023467.1 are benchmark-assembly ids, not disconfirmed.

provenance_quote: Using mariner mutagenesis and a screen for loss of cytotoxicity, a genetic locus encoding an RTX toxin system was identified. ... We concluded that K. kingae expresses an RTX toxin that has wide cellular specificity
notes: DOI 10.1128/JB.01319-06 = Kehl-Fie & St Geme 2007 J Bacteriol 189:430-6, PMID 17098895, resolves and on-topic (identification of RTX toxin in K. kingae). RTX toxins are canonical T1SS substrates.
